SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No...........
S.I, Special Branch XXXX
REPORT
Date October 20, 19 37.
Subject "All China Labour Circles National Salvation Association
to resist the Enemy" - Organization.
Made by D.S.I. hao Yen-ken Forwarded by C. Crawford J.J

A new organization entitled "Preparatory Committee
of All China Labour Circles National Salvation Association
to resist the Enemy" (中國全國工界抗敵救亡協會)
was formed on October 14 at a meeting of twenty persons held
in the Special District Office of the Ricksha Owners'
Association, 81 Lloyd Road. It has no office but two
communication addresses : (1) c/o Mr. Chen Yin-ming (陳英民),
Lane 614, 13 Foochow Road, and (2) c/o Mr. Chen Kuo-liang
(陳國), 276 Rue Capitaine Fabier. The following
persons were appointed to serve on the Preparatory Committee:-
Mr. Chen Kuo-liang (陳國樑),
a notorious ricsha coolie agitator living at
276 Rue Capitaine Fabier.
Mr. Chang Tseng-kong (張振剛),
a clerk of the 2nd Special District Citizens'
Federation, 434 Rue Auguste Boppe.
Mr. Wei Jih (魏傑),
a staff employee of the Oppel Electric Bulb Factory,
90 Avenue Dubail.
Mr. Chow Ting-san (周鼎三),
a carpenter by profession, living at 87 Rue Bourgeat.
Mr. Kan Wei-tseng (耿金珍),
a farmer and an ordure coolie at Nantao, living in
a straw hut beside Chiang Chun Miao (將軍廟),
Nantao.
Mr. Bi Chang-fah (卞長發),
a ricsha coolie living on Rue Gugout.
Mr. Chen Ying-ming (陳英民),
a clerk of the 20th District Branch of the 1st
District Citizens' Federation, Lane 614, 13
Foochow Road.
Mr. Sung Kuh-dien (孫古田),
a farmer and an ordure coolie at Nantao, living
in a straw hut on Zia Tu Road, Nantao.
Mr. Liu Chang-pah (劉長柏),
a farmer living at 572 Dong Tuh Li (同德里),
Li Yuan Road, Nantao.
Mr. Liu Ming-chi (劉明岐),
proprietor of the Hung Ziang Timepiece Shop (鴻祥鐘表店)
Yunnan Road.

(批：K.I.V to eradicate Rtn)
(印：nfs 21 OCT 103)
(批：S.I. as indicated D&R C.D.S. Ck C-8/10 88/jc)

报告
日期：1937年10月20日。
主题：“全中国工界抗敌救亡协会”——组织情况。
制作人：特别巡捕 郝延根（Hao Yen-ken） 转呈人：C. Crawford J.J

一个名为“全中国工界抗敌救亡协会筹备委员会”（中國全國工界抗敵救亡協會）的新组织于10月14日成立，成立会议在劳合路（Lloyd Road）81号人力车车主协会特别区办事处举行，共有二十人出席。该会尚无办公地点，但有两个通讯地址：(1) 福州路13号614弄陈英民（Chen Yin-ming）先生转；(2) 法必耶上尉路（Rue Capitaine Fabier）276号陈国樑（Chen Kuo-liang）先生转。以下人员被任命为筹备委员会委员：

陈国樑（Chen Kuo-liang）先生，
臭名昭著的人力车夫煽动者，居住于法必耶上尉路276号。

张振刚（Chang Tseng-kong）先生，
第二特区市民联合会职员，地址为奥古斯特·博佩路（Rue Auguste Boppe）434号。

魏杰（Wei Jih）先生，
欧培尔灯泡厂（Oppel Electric Bulb Factory）职员，地址为杜白尔路（Avenue Dubail）90号。

周鼎三（Chow Ting-san）先生，
职业为木匠，居住于布尔热路（Rue Bourgeat）87号。

耿金珍（Kan Wei-tseng）先生，
南市农民及粪夫，居住于南市将军庙（Chiang Chun Miao）旁的草棚内。

卞长发（Bi Chang-fah）先生，
人力车夫，居住于古古特路（Rue Gugout）。

陈英民（Chen Ying-ming）先生，
第一区市民联合会第二十区分部职员，地址为福州路13号614弄。

孙古田（Sung Kuh-dien）先生，
南市农民及粪夫，居住于南市斜土路（Zia Tu Road）的草棚内。

刘长柏（Liu Chang-pah）先生，
农民，居住于南市梨园路同德里572号。

刘明岐（Liu Ming-chi）先生，
鸿祥钟表店店主，位于云南路。

(批：阅存，待消除回转)
(印：nfs 1937年10月21日)

Date October 22, , 37.
Subject "All China Labour Circles National Salvation Association
to Resist the Enemy" - Meeting.
Made by D.S.I. Kao Yen-ken Forwarded by C [Signature]

About 30 members of the "Preparatory Committee of
All China Labour Circles National Salvation Association to
Resist the Enemy" held a meeting in the Special District Office
of the Ricsha Owners' Association, 81 Lloyd Road, between
3 p.m. and 4 p.m. October 21. Mr. Chen Kuo-liang (陳國樑),
a notorious ricsha coolie agitator, presided. The following
persons were appointed :-

General Affairs : Mr. Chen Kuo-liang.
Mr. Chang Tseng-kong.
Mr. Wong Yih-chong (王益昌), clerk
of the Preparatory Committee, living
at 176 Chao Lya Road, Nantao.

Organization : Mr. Wei Jih.
Mr. Chwang Wen-dzu (章文孺), an
unemployed school teacher.

Propaganda : Mr. Wong Yih-chong.
Mr. Chen Kuo-liang.
Mr. Chen Ying-ming.
Mr. Ling Sung-hai (林聖海), ex-clerk
of the Shanghai Power Company, living
at 14 Yih Teh Li (益德里), Rue
Lafayette.

Advisor : Mr. Hsu Hwei-zuan (許煥然), a
detective attached to the Woosung-
Shanghai Military Headquarters.

At the conclusion of the meeting, it was decided
to inaugurate the Association in the Special District Office
of the Ricsha Owners' Association, 81 Lloyd Road, on November 1.

(批：After inspection I completed under consideration.)
(批：B)

Copies sent to D.O.A. Kao Yen-ken
& Ricsha Control Officer D. S. I.
for information. D.B.?
D. C. (Special Branch). 22/10.

X S.I.

日期：1937年10月22日。
主题：“全中国工界抗敌救亡协会”——会议情况。
制作人：特别巡捕 高延根（Kao Yen-ken） 转呈人：C [签名]

约30名“全中国工界抗敌救亡协会筹备委员会”成员于10月21日下午3时至4时之间，在劳合路81号人力车车主协会特别区办事处举行会议。会议由臭名昭著的人力车夫煽动者陈国樑（Chen Kuo-liang）先生主持。以下人员获任命：

总务：陈国樑先生。
张振刚先生。
王益昌（Wong Yih-chong）先生，筹备委员会职员，居住于南市兆丰路（Chao Lya Road）176号。

组织：魏杰先生。
章文孺（Chwang Wen-dzu）先生，失业教师。

宣传：王益昌先生。
陈国樑先生。
陈英民先生。
林圣海（Ling Sung-hai）先生，前上海电力公司职员，居住于辣斐德路（Rue Lafayette）益德里14号。

顾问：许焕然（Hsu Hwei-zuan）先生，吴淞-上海军事司令部侦缉员。

会议结束时，决定于11月1日在劳合路81号人力车车主协会特别区办事处正式成立该协会。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No............
Station,
REPORT
Date ............ 19

Subject ........................................ - 2 -

Made by................................ Forwarded by................................

Mr. Co Sun-yu (□□□),
a lawyer with an office at 81 Lloyd Road.

Although Mr. Co Sun-yu was appointed as a
Member of the Preparatory Committee, he declined to accept
the position.

According to Mr. Chen Kuo-liang, the principal
promoter, the main object of the Association is to endeavour
to arrange for each labourer to contribute $0.10 per mensem
for national salvation purposes and also to train unemployed
workers for services behind the Chinese front lines.

When asked if any work was scheduled to be carried out in
the Settlement, Mr. Chen stated that propaganda bearing on
national salvation might be carried out in tram and cinemas
situated there. On being advised that no political
activity would be tolerated unless permission was first
obtained, he stated that he would address the Municipal Police
by letter prior to any activity being conducted in the
Settlement.

Mr. Chen attempted to convene a meeting of the
members of the Preparatory Committee on October 18 in the
Special District Office of the Ricsha Owners' Association,
but had to abandon the project because of the non-attendance
of members.

It would appear that Mr. Chen Kuo-liang is working
for his own ends in starting such an organization. It
has not even the support of one of the local labour unions, and
in view of this fact, the Bureau of Social Affairs is paying
close attention to the activities of the Association.

Dist:- D.O.A. & March below. Kao Yen-ken
D.C. (Special Branch). D.B.
D. S. I.
2/10.

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
档案号............
警署，
报告
日期：............ 19

主题 ........................................ - 2 -

制作人................................ 转呈人................................

曹孙玉（Co Sun-yu）先生（□□□），
律师，办公室位于劳合路81号。

尽管曹孙玉先生被任命为筹备委员会委员，但他拒绝接受该职位。

据主要发起人陈国樑先生称，该协会的主要目标是努力安排每位劳工每月捐款0.10元用于救国目的，并训练失业工人以为中国前线后方服务。

当被问及是否计划在租界内开展任何工作时，陈先生表示，可能会在有轨电车和电影院进行与救国有关的宣传。在被告知除非事先获得许可，否则不容忍任何政治活动后，他表示在进行任何租界内的活动之前，将以书信形式致函工部局警务处。

陈先生曾试图于10月18日在劳合路81号人力车车主协会特别区办事处召开筹备委员会成员会议，但因成员缺席而不得不放弃该计划。

看来陈国樑先生发起此类组织是为一己之私。该组织甚至没有得到当地任何一个工会的支持，鉴于这一事实，社会局正密切关注该协会的活动。

分发：行动处处长 及下文署名。高延根
副总监（特别股）。D.B.
特别巡捕
10月2日。
